name: AgencyAnalytics
description: AgencyAnalytics is the only reporting and insights platform built for marketing agencies. Connect every client's marketing channels into one place across SEO, PPC, social media, email, call tracking, ecommerce, and more, with 85+ integrations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AgencyAnalytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AgencyAnalytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.agencyanalytics.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AgencyAnalytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AgencyAnalytics lists 24 MCP tools, including browse_client_custom_metrics, browse_client_custom_views, browse_client_dashboards, browse_client_data_sources, browse_client_reports, browse_clients, create_client, create_client_custom_metric, create_client_custom_view, create_mcp_feedback, create_user, and fetch_web.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AgencyAnalytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AgencyAnalytics in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
AgencyAnalytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AgencyAnalytics is developed by AgencyAnalytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
